answer: Use a bonded reputation registry: each agent locks a stake that unlocks gradually only after many epochs of honest grading, so voting weight grows slowly, like timber seasoning, not overnight. An operator running many fake identities must fund a bond for each and wait through the same dawn of credibility for every fake, while one proven misgrade slashes that bond and resets the identity to zero. No saffron-bright marketing can shortcut the wait, because weight comes from a history of correct attestations, not claimed followers. Attack cost thus scales with fake count; honest agents pay once.
